description_en: Call CreateQualityRule to create a Quality Rule
description_zh: 调用CreateQualityRule创建质量监控规则
name: CreateQualityRule

parameters.help_en:
The strength of the rule. Valid values:

0: weak rule

1: strong rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则的强弱：

0表示弱规则
1表示强规则
parameters.name: block_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the partition filter expression
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式的ID
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The comments of the rule
parameters.help_zh: 规则的描述信息
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the checker. Valid values:

2: 7-day average fluctuation

3: 30-day average fluctuation

4: day-over-day comparison

5: week-over-week comparison

6: month-over-month comparison

7: 7-day variance fluctuation

8: 30-day variance fluctuation

9: comparison with a fixed value

10: fluctuation detection over 1, 7, and 30 days

11: comparison with the previous cycle
parameters.help_zh:
校验器的ID，取值如下：

2，表示7天平均值波动。
3，表示30天平均值波动。
4，表示1天周期比较。
5，表示7天周期比较。
6，表示30天周期比较。
7，表示7天方差波动。
8，表示30天方差波动。
9，表示与固定值比较。
10，表示1、7、30天波动检测。
11，表示上一周期比较
parameters.name: checker

parameters.help_en: The expected value
parameters.help_zh: 期望值
parameters.name: expect_value

parameters.help_en:
The trend of the check result. Valid values:

`up`: upward trend

`down`: downward trend

`abs`: absolute value
parameters.help_zh:
校验结果的趋势。取值如下：
up，表示上升趋势。
down，表示下降趋势。
abs，表示绝对值
parameters.name: trend

parameters.help_en: The check method. If you use a custom SQL statement, set this parameter to `user_defined`
parameters.help_zh: 采样方。如果是自定义SQL，该参数的值为user_defined
parameters.name: method_name

parameters.help_en:
The comparison operator. Examples: `>`, `>=`, `=`, `<>`, `<`, and `<=`.

If you set the Checker parameter to 9, you must specify the Operator parameter
parameters.help_zh:
比较符。包括>、>=、=、≠、<和<=等。

当Checker=9时，Operator为必选参数
parameters.name: operator

parameters.help_en: The name of the compute engine or data source
parameters.help_zh: 引擎或者数据源的名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The field that is monitored by the rule. To perform a table-level check, set this parameter to `table_count` for the number of rows or `table_size` for the table size
parameters.help_zh: 规则的字段。如果是表级别校验，行数为table_count、大小为table_size字段
parameters.name: property

parameters.help_en: The data type of the field. For a table-level check, set this parameter to `table`. For a field-level check, set this parameter to a specific data type, such as `bigint`
parameters.help_zh: 字段的类型，表级table，字段级填写bigint等
parameters.name: property_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

0: system template

1: custom SQL

2: custom template
parameters.help_zh:
规则的类型：
0：系统模板规则
1：自定义SQL规则
4：自定义模板规则
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The filter condition or custom SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 过滤条件或自定义SQL
parameters.name: where_condition

parameters.help_en: The critical threshold. It indicates the deviation of the check result from the expected value. You can customize this threshold based on your business requirements. If a strong rule is used and a critical alert is triggered, the scheduling task is blocked
parameters.help_zh: 红色告警阈值。表示与样本预期的偏离程度。您可以根据业务需求自定义该阈值。使用强规则并触发红色阈值，会阻塞调度任务
parameters.name: critical_threshold

parameters.help_en: The warning threshold. It indicates the deviation of the check result from the expected value. You can customize this threshold based on your business requirements
parameters.help_zh: 橙色告警阈值。表示与样本预期的偏离程度，您可以根据业务需求自定义该阈值
parameters.name: warning_threshold

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template
parameters.help_zh: 模板的ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule
parameters.help_zh: 规则的名称
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use a dynamic threshold. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 是否为动态阈值：0表示非动态阈值、2表示动态阈值规则
parameters.name: predict_type

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The variable settings that are inserted before the custom rule. Format: x=a,y=b
parameters.help_zh: 在自定义规则之前插入的变量设置，格式如：x=a,y=b
parameters.name: task_setting

Data.description_en: The ID of the new rule
